You have Atlassian MCP tools available but they are DEFERRED. First run:
ToolSearch with query "select:mcp__mcp-atlassian__confluence_get_page,mcp__mcp-atlassian__confluence_search" and max_results 5.

Then fetch Confluence page ID 302776322 (title "04.1.8 Product, Catalogue and PDP", space SFCC) using mcp__mcp-atlassian__confluence_get_page with page_id="302776322", include_metadata=true, convert_to_markdown=true.

This page is a large requirements table with Req ID prefix "PRD". Columns are: Req ID | Functional Area | Sub-Functional Area | Requirement | Owner | Storefront | Config/Custom | Status | Comments | User Story Link.

Extract and report back VERBATIM (exact wording, do not paraphrase) every row where ANY of these is true:
1. Req ID is exactly PRD-027 (this is the highest priority — I need its full text, its Sub-Functional Area, its Status, and its Comments column, quoted exactly).
2. The Requirement or Comments text mentions "Recently Viewed", "recently viewed", "browsing history", "browsing session", "session history".
3. The Requirement or Comments text mentions "product tile", "product card", "tile", or "card" in a UI sense.
4. The Requirement or Comments text mentions "wishlist" in a way that describes what is displayed on a tile/card.
5. The Requirement mentions badges on tiles, hover image swap, colour swatches on tiles, or quick-add / add-to-bag from a tile.

Also report:
- The page's version number (from metadata) and any "last updated" text visible in the page body.
- Whether any row is struck through (the page marks out-of-scope rows with strikethrough, rendered as ~~text~~ in markdown) — say explicitly if PRD-027 or any row you report is struck through.
- The total count of PRD rows on the page, and the ID range (e.g. PRD-001 to PRD-0NN).

If PRD-027 does not exist on the page, say so explicitly and clearly — that is an important finding, not a failure. In that case, list the Req IDs immediately around where it would be (PRD-024 through PRD-030) with their requirement text so I can see what is there instead.

Do NOT create, update, or comment on any Confluence page. Read-only. Do not write any files. Return your findings directly as your final message.
